title: agent-memory-merge — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins the agent-memory catalog merge rules in myne-core (myne-md/myne#697): the per-id causal join over records, remove-wins tombstones on equal-version ties, and three-way associativity. Pure logic over decoded plaintexts; no keys, no AEAD. Spec contract is docs/spec/sync-protocol.md §10.2.6 + §11.4.

expected_merged.description: A memory catalog map: entry-id hex (32 lowercase chars, no separators) to roster row, exactly as serde reads MemoryEntryRow.

additionalProperties.description: One roster row, the MemoryEntryRow shape (myne-core). The entry TEXT is not here: it lives in the memories/<id> file, so a merge vector can only pin the roster (timestamps, tombstone, causal version).

deleted_at.description: Tombstone marker. Present = the entry is deleted everywhere; remove-wins over a concurrent live edit.

version.description: Causal merge counter, the sync race key (absent reads as 0).
